title: Teen numbers: 10 and some more
examples: How do I know when to make a group of ten?
What does it mean to have ten and some more?
Can we count past ten using rods?

explain.say: Teen numbers are ten and some more. So you make a group of ten first.
Your ten fingers make one full ten. A rod of ten cubes shows one ten too.
One ten and four more ones make fourteen. Ten and four is fourteen.
Look at the number fourteen. The one stands for one ten. The four stands for four ones.
Nineteen is one ten and nine ones. Add one more, and you have twenty. Twenty is two tens.

faq.a: A ten group is just ten things put together. It is a neat way to count ten items.
asks: What does it mean to group by ten?
How many things are in one ten group?

faq.q: Why do we use rods to show tens?
faq.a: A rod of ten cubes helps you see a whole ten at once. It keeps your counting neat.
asks: Are rods just for showing ten?
Why can't we just count them normally?

faq.q: How do I show the number seventeen?
faq.a: You show it as one ten and seven ones. Ten and seven make seventeen.
asks: What is 17 in tens and ones?
Can you show me seventeen with rods?

faq.q: Is ten plus five always fifteen?
faq.a: Yes, ten plus five always equals fifteen. You just count on from ten.
asks: If I have ten and five more, what is it?
Does ten plus five equal fifteen?

faq.q: What is the difference between ten and one?
faq.a: Ten is a full group of ten things. One is just a single item by itself.
asks: What is the difference between 10 and 1?
When do I use a ten rod versus a single rod?

facts: A ten group always contains exactly ten items.
When counting, we count the full tens first, then the ones.
Ten plus any number is just counting up from ten.
The number eleven is one ten and one more.

quiz.say: Look at one ten and some ones. Tap the number.
quiz.why: One ten and five ones make fifteen.

wrong.0: Fifty-one has five tens, and here you see just one ten.
wrong.1: The ten counts as ten, so count on from ten.

quiz.say: Look at 19. Tap the tens and ones.
quiz.why: Nineteen is one ten and nine ones. The 9 stands for nine ones.

wrong.0: One ten and one one make eleven, so look at the 9 again.
wrong.2: Nine tens make ninety, and 19 has just one ten.

quiz.say: Count on from ten. Tap the number.
quiz.why: Ten and six more make sixteen. You count on: eleven, twelve, up to sixteen.

wrong.1: Sixty is six tens, and here there is one ten and six ones.
wrong.2: Count the dots again, because there are six ones.
